verdict.rationale: Exporting all account data in open formats is a fair question for a SaaS video platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows per-video output exports (4K video export, SCORM export for LMS). These are adjacent features: they render individual deliverables rather than providing bulk data portability, such as avatars, voice clones, scripts, projects and assets in open formats, for leaving the platform. No documented account-wide export or data-portability capability appears in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
